about: T-474 / T-473 INDEX checks, 2026-10-28 on v11.320.1: after PENGUIN FOR DOLPHIN (PENPHIN arrives by trade), PENPHIN's INDEX entry -- its area page's FIRST MET (A TRADE) and its workings (L) reading the pair's line, ->PENGUIN PENPHIN. A-Z MODE paged to P. The A-Z list's A opens the FAMILY page (cursor on the daemon), whose L/R turn family pages; a second A opens the entry, whose L turns the workings and whose A opens the area page (src/pokedex_screen.c, Task_DexScreen_CategorySubmenu states 5, 17, 23). The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's. The A-Z list's paging drifts between boots, so the first stop keeps the list's first page as a savestate and the second pages from it.
